page_text_en:
I heard people call handsome men 'Mr.'
'Mr., I am completely a Mr.!' the little bear said to himself, feeling very proud.
The little bear walked toward the forest and met a little deer halfway.
The deer happily greeted him: 'Little bear, hello!'
The little bear said to the deer: 'You should call me Mr. Look, how much I resemble a gentleman!'
Just as he was speaking, a strong wind blew from the forest, blowing the hat off the little bear's head and rolling it on the ground.
The little bear was just about to bend down to pick up his hat when suddenly he heard a cry of 'Oh!'
summary_zh: 小熊戴着用棕榈叶编成的帽子，自认为相貌堂堂，向森林走去时遇到小鹿，得意地要求对方称呼自己为先生，正说着，一阵大风吹落了他的帽子，他刚想捡起时，突然听到一声惊叫。

page_text_ocr_zh:
原来小鹿的眼睛叫沙粒给迷住了。小熊马上转过身来，帮小鹿轻轻翻弄眼睛，把沙粒取了出来。

小鹿高兴地笑了。小熊突然想起了他心爱的帽子。可是，它已经在地上滚了整整一百个滚儿，掉进了小溪里。

一条顽皮的小鲇鱼，正顶着它在水里游呢！

“小熊先生！”小鹿亲切地说，
“你真像一位先生，不是因为你漂亮的帽子，而是因为你热心帮助别人。”
page_text_en:
The deer's eyes had been irritated by a grain of sand. The bear quickly turned around and gently rubbed the deer's eyes to remove the sand.

The deer smiled happily. The bear suddenly remembered his beloved hat. But it had rolled on the ground for a hundred times and fallen into the stream.

A mischievous catfish was playfully pushing it around in the water!

"Mr. Bear!" the deer said warmly,
"You truly look like a gentleman, not because of your beautiful hat, but because you are kind and helpful to others."
summary_zh: 小熊帮助小鹿取出了眼睛里的沙粒，小鹿感激地称赞他像一位先生，因为他的热心助人，而非帽子。小熊的帽子则被一条小鲇鱼顶着在溪里游动。

page_text_ocr_zh:
“哦，小鹿叫我先生了……”小熊
望着远远漂去的帽子，显得很高兴。
page_text_en:
"Oh, the little deer called me 'Mr.'..." The little bear
looked at his hat drifting away in the distance, looking very happy.
summary_zh: 小熊看到自己的帽子被小鲇鱼顶着漂走，却因小鹿称他为先生而感到高兴。
